set.body: Add explicit connectivity projection separating eligibility, selection score, selection policy, weight transform, diagonal treatment, and post-transform zero policy. Reject rectangular EdgeSpace in v1. Return canonical graph order plus ProjectionReceipt and an injective source EdgeSpace coordinate correspondence. Cover density ties, signed preservation, distance handling, replay determinism, and scientific basis provenance.
set.title: Connectivity: typed matrix-to-graph projection with provenance and correspondence
